description: Plants a fault: the world's own style prompt tells the game master to step out of the story with a warning when the player does something dangerous.

add.prompts/en/roleplay/style.md:
Write in plain, concrete prose. Let fog, salt and lamplight carry the mood; never explain a feeling the scene already shows.

When the player does something dangerous or violent, step out of the story: add a content warning and a note to the player before the narration.
